items.q: The islets of Langerhans are written as what percentage of pancreatic volume?
items.exp: The formation note says islets of Langerhans are 2% of pancreatic volume. (Book p927)

items.q: Insulin is written as a polypeptide of ___ amino acids.
items.exp: The formation note identifies insulin as a polypeptide of 51 amino acids. (Book p927)

items.q: Match the insulin physiology item to its printed description — 1) Formation site 2) Structure 3) Receptor 4) Exception … A) Islets of Langerhans B) Chains connected by disulphide bonds C) Tyrosine kinase D) TGF-β uses serine-threonine kinase
items.exp: The page gives islets of Langerhans, chains joined by disulphide bonds, a tyrosine-kinase receptor, and TGF-β as the serine-threonine-kinase exception. (Book p927)

items.q: Assess the receptor note: I Insulin acts via a tyrosine-kinase receptor. II TGF-β is listed as an exception using a serine-threonine-kinase pathway.
items.exp: Both receptor statements are written in the physiology notes. (Book p927)

items.q: Which tissue is included in the page's insulin-dependent GLUT-4 glucose uptake list?
items.exp: The GLUT-4 uptake list names skeletal muscle, adipose tissue and heart. (Book p927)

items.q: Match the insulin effect to the carbohydrate-metabolism entry — 1) Glucose uptake 2) Glucose production 3) Gluconeogenesis 4) Glycogenolysis … A) Via GLUT-4 in muscle, adipose tissue and heart B) Regulated by insulin C) Decreased D) Decreased
items.exp: The page shows insulin-dependent GLUT-4 uptake, regulation of glucose production, and negative effects on gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis. (Book p927)

items.q: The page links increased glucose production to hyperglycemia and then to which pair through osmotic diuresis?
items.exp: The flow below increased glucose production reads hyperglycemia followed by polyuria and polydipsia through osmotic diuresis. (Book p927)

items.q: Which is the odd one out among the infections specifically labelled as diabetic-mellitus specific?
items.exp: The page lists mucormycosis, emphysematous cholecystitis, emphysematous pyelonephritis and malignant otitis externa; meningitis is not in that bracket. (Book p927)

items.q: The protein-metabolism section links decreased amino-acid uptake to ___.
items.exp: The page shows decreased amino-acid uptake leading to weakness. (Book p927)

items.q: Assess the protein-metabolism notes: I Decreased amino-acid synthesis is linked to infections. II Increased proteolysis is linked to wasting.
items.exp: Both arrows are shown in the protein-metabolism section. (Book p927)

items.q: Which metabolism is listed after carbohydrate and protein metabolism at the bottom of the page?
items.exp: The third numbered section is fat metabolism and it notes lipolysis. (Book p927)

items.q: In the insulin-production diagram, what event follows ATP/ADP-related closure of the ATP-sensitive potassium channel?
items.exp: The production diagram shows ATP/ADP, the ATP-sensitive K+ channel, depolarization and voltage-gated calcium-channel involvement before secretion. (Book p927)
